VARIANT [profile-parameter] When a procession or another liturgical function immediately follows
the Mass, the priest says 'Benedicamus Domino' facing the ALTAR instead of 'Ite, missa est'
facing the people. There is no blessing and no Last Gospel.
VARIANT [requiem] At a Requiem the priest says 'Requiescant in pace' facing the ALTAR; the
server answers 'Amen'. There is no blessing. The Last Gospel is omitted if the absolution over
the catafalque follows, and is otherwise said.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-ROLE-01, INV-NAME-01,

“Benedicat vos omnipotens Deus, Pater, et Filius, et Spiritus Sanctus”
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces people · eyes people · L on-breast / R blessing
AC1: kneeling · bow head-slight · step-1-epistle · faces altar · eyes downcast · L on-breast / R

VARIANT [profile-parameter] When 'Benedicamus Domino' was said because a procession or another
liturgical function immediately follows, there is no blessing.
VARIANT [requiem] At a Requiem, where 'Requiescant in pace' was said, there is no blessing.

UNRESOLVED: The approved record specifies a 'simple bow' for the servers at 'Benedicat vos
omnipotens Deus' without fixing its depth.
